verdict_reason: Sentinel-1/2 fully open via GEE. EOS-04 (RISAT-1A) requires Bhoonidhi registration + EULA under India's mixed open/priced Space Data Policy 2023 (application_required). Insurance-unit-level CCE ground truth is named (PMFBY/AgriStack) but not confirmed downloadable: yestech portal unreachable, data.gov.in resource returned 403.

ground_truth.construction_protocol: Named source: Crop-Cutting-Experiment (CCE) yield data used by PMFBY/YES-TECH to validate estimates. IU-level CCE not confirmed publicly downloadable; only district aggregates found. Needs application/partnership with PMFBY, AgriStack or state Agriculture Dept for IU-level records.

compute_path.platform: Google Earth Engine (JS/Python API) for Sentinel-1/2 time series; offline CPU tools (SNAP/rasterio) for downloaded EOS-04 SAR scenes
compute_path.why: Sentinel-1/2 run entirely in GEE hosted compute. EOS-04 is downloaded and processed with CPU-based SAR tools; rule-based disagreement flagging needs no sustained GPU training.
